tools.name: ecourier_get_order
tools.description: One delivery order with everything e-Courier holds: status (N new, A assigned, X deleted), customer, stops and their pickup/delivery times and POD names, pieces, jobs and drivers, fees, events and notifications. Give exactly one of order_number, order_id, auth (the customer's authorization code) or

tools.name: ecourier_get_order_fees
tools.description: The fee lines (what was charged for the delivery: base rate, fuel, waiting time and so on) of one order, by internal order id. GetOrderFees.

tools.name: ecourier_quote_order
tools.description: Price and availability for a delivery WITHOUT creating it: e-Courier applies the customer's rates to the stops and pieces and returns the order with the quoted amount. Supply a customer code, pickup/delivery stops and optional pieces. Nothing is saved and nobody is notified. QuoteOrder.

tools.name: ecourier_get_customer_by_code
tools.description: A customer (billing account) by its e-Courier customer code: id, name and address. GetCustomerByCode.

tools.name: ecourier_get_customer
tools.description: The full customer record by internal customer id: contact, address, credit status and limit, balance, billing settings. Card numbers and passwords are never returned. GetCustomerById.

tools.name: ecourier_find_customer_by_phone
tools.description: Look up a customer by phone number (useful when a caller rings in): id, name and address. GetCustomerInfoFromPhoneNumber.

tools.name: ecourier_list_customer_ship_tos
tools.description: The saved ship-to (stop) addresses of a customer, by internal customer id, or one ship-to by its id. Give exactly one. GetCustomerShipTo.

tools.name: ecourier_list_drivers
tools.description: Every active driver: id, code, name and site. Optionally only one site (multi-site accounts). GetDrivers.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver
tools.description: Driver records with their vehicles and file names (never SSN or tax ids). With driver_id or driver_code one driver; with neither, every active and inactive driver. GetDriver.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver_orders
tools.description: What a driver is carrying right now: the open orders on the driver's manifest (customer, pickup and delivery names, delivery zip, ready and due times), found by driver code or by the driver's phone number. Give exactly one. GetDriverInfoFromDriverCode / GetDriverInfoFromDriverPhone.

tools.name: ecourier_list_skills
tools.description: The master list of active driver skills (for example HAZMAT) with ids. GetSkills.

tools.name: ecourier_get_driver_skills
tools.description: The skills assigned to one driver, by driver id or driver code (give exactly one). GetDriverSkills.

tools.name: ecourier_get_manifest
tools.description: One driver manifest (the route a driver runs for a day) with all its job stops: sequence, addresses, status, pieces and weight. GetManifest.

tools.name: ecourier_list_driver_manifests
tools.description: The manifests of one driver between two dates, with their job stops. Default status filter is active (A). GetManifestsByDriver.

tools.name: ecourier_list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices in an invoice date range (invoice_start_date and invoice_end_date are both required, at most 31 days apart: e-Courier rejects anything else). Optionally narrow by customer code and by a last-changed range. GetInvoice.

tools.name: ecourier_get_invoice_fees
tools.description: The fee lines of one invoice, by invoice id (the id from ecourier_list_invoices). GetInvoiceFees.

tools.name: ecourier_list_payments
tools.description: Customer payments received in a payment date range (payment_start_date and payment_end_date are both required, at most 10 days apart: e-Courier rejects anything else). Optionally narrow by customer code, check number or payment id. GetPayment.
